items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: J.P. Johnson sitting over there playing the piano.

ctx.x: We could rub elbows with the top men, you know. (Inaudible) walk in a place -- there's Coleman Hawkins over there, there's Louie over there, Errol Garner, Fats Waller and all those boys sitting around there.
J.P. Johnson sitting over there playing the piano. Earl Hines walk in or something like this. Hey man.
Some of these musicians you're talking about at the -- when the stock market fell and these, say, dime dances and so forth, who were some of the big name musicians who did come in there to play?
